_comment: SUBMISSIONS PAGE COPY (Arabic). The two form cards (project submission + promo video) are near-identical, so they're one 'forms' array rendered by a single loop in submissions.njk instead of two copy-pasted card blocks — and the copy-to-clipboard button now reuses one shared JS function instead of two nearly-identical click handlers (see pageScript in the template). The two original error messages differed slightly in wording for no clear reason; unified to the fuller one.
